decisions.reason: The distribution options and full-gold comparison reference are already fully represented by the candidate's message 185 INTRODUCE Event; no additional propagated MODIFY is needed.
The selection of Brushed Metallic and Satin Reflection as the finishes for comparison is already fully represented by the candidate's message 185 MODIFY Event.
The requested material-comparison matrix changes presentation and color-distribution studies, not which geometric assets are locked or how revisions must preserve them.
Applying champagne gold to the Hero V right arm for comparison does not change the Hero V's approved geometry, construction, proportions, or identity role.
The source specifies comparative material treatments but does not change the accepted delivery formats for accessible review images.
The source requests comparison of champagne-gold applications and finishes without changing the selected kerning or spacing rules.
The material-treatment comparison does not alter the shared-baseline alignment requirement.
Applying gold to the second V's right arm in one visual-treatment option does not change its optical construction, design DNA, or right-arm geometry.
The source changes color distribution for comparison but leaves the second V's height and cap-height relationships unchanged.
Keeping all non-highlighted elements black in the proposed treatments does not modify the E and L letterforms' geometry, scale, or architectural design constraints.
Applying champagne gold to the É accent in one option does not change its required literal derivation from the Hero V terminal.
The requested material and color comparison does not alter the required peak alignment between the É accent and Hero V.
